reason: Verified per-site (RFC 0106): `define_method("regenerate_#{attribute}")` (`secure_token.rb:49`) — JS has no `define_method`; the settled spelling is `Object.defineProperty` on the prototype.

Verified per-site (RFC 0106): `set_callback on, on == :initialize ? :after : :before` (`secure_token.rb:50`) — AR's callbacks in trails are registered on their own per-prototype registry (`callbacks.ts` `registerCallback`), not on an ActiveSupport `CallbackChain`, so ActiveSupport's `setCallback` has no chain named "create"/"initialize" to reach and the `beforeCreate`/`afterInitialize` helpers are the only route.
